description: Renovate proposes every dependency update and merges it once every check on the pull request has passed (none is required on this repository, so Renovate waits for the ones that run: platformAutomerge is off and it merges on its next run). A new version waits three days after its release (minimumReleaseAge); fixes for vulnerability alerts skip the wait by Renovate's default. timestamp-optional lets an update from a registry that reports no release date through. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#minimumreleaseage

packageRules.description: An image rebuild (a new digest under the same tag) doesn't wait: Docker Hub dates a rebuild by the tag's last push, so a tag rebuilt about weekly would restart the clock each time and never clear the wait.
